judgments.rationale: Populating the action field with 'inspect or examine' merely extracts text already fully stated and understood in the existing claim summary without adding missing governing conditions, exceptions, or legal meaning. Such an edit constitutes unnecessary field filling.

Rephrasing 'may' to 'is permitted to' while copying the action 'inspect or examine' from the existing summary into an empty optional field does not add needed legal meaning, resolve ambiguity, or supply missing criteria. This is unnecessary field filling.

Items (I) and (II) under (ii) are disjunctive alternatives separated by 'or'. Records relating to a firearm involved in a criminal investigation traced to the licensee may be inspected 'at any time' under subclause (II), rather than being restricted to 'not more than once during any 12-month period' under subclause (I). The proposed summary incorrectly imposes the 12-month restriction onto traced firearm records.
